api.notes: String labels; rich ReactNode labels go in the default slot.

api.reason: The host's own aria-label attribute is native and wins over the default name set through ElementInternals.
A-xstyle: use class/style, ::part(spinner), and the --spinner-* custom properties.
Any attribute can be set on the host; not component API.

differences.text: The host is an indeterminate progressbar (role via ElementInternals, name from aria-label, the label text, or the localised 'Loading') instead of a role=status span; nothing announces on its own, the owning component announces (A§9.16).
The default shade paints from the Tecton progress roles (--tecton-color-progress-primary and -track) like the owner's progress components, not --color-accent (a fill in Tecton).
The shade value `onMedia` is `on-media` (kebab-case attribute values).
The private geometry properties are not registered with CSS.registerProperty (@property is document-level, A§5.4); the --spinner-* lengths therefore need a unit (0px, not 0).

core.spinner.notes: Guides: [mwg:accessible-web-components] progressbar role and name through ElementInternals; [mwg:css] reduced motion slows instead of stopping, forced colours; [mwg:shadow-dom] slot fallback content for the label; [mwg:styling-web-components] admitted custom properties read through private aliases.
